verdict.rationale: The docs say the OCR handles images (PNG, JPEG and others) and works 'even from low-quality or handwritten sources.' Several independent users report strong accuracy on severely degraded 55-year-old paper files, low-resolution text and handwritten forms. One user did report a page wrongly returned as a single image, a real but isolated counter-example. Missing for 10: any evidence for skewed or rotated page handling, any evidence for stamps or overlaid marks, and benchmarks specific to photographed documents.
